name: @untch/policy-store
description: Untch policy store (PRD §6.2 / §8 / §10.1). Durable Postgres policy CRUD whose id IS the on-chain PolicyRegistry policyId, anchored by real registerPolicy/updatePolicy/pausePolicy calls on X Layer. Postgres is synced from what the chain confirms; the policyId is derived from the live on-chain owner nonce, never an off-chain counter.
